features.name: spam_word_composite_score
features.description: Weighted sum of high-spam-indicator word frequencies (money, free, business, credit-related terms) normalized by log1p transform for smooth SVM margins
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple spam-indicative word signals into a single smooth continuous score, reducing dimensionality and providing a strong linear separator
features.formula: np.log1p(word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_20)

features.name: capital_run_severity
features.description: Log-normalized composite of capital letter run statistics capturing aggressive capitalization patterns common in spam
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines three capital run metrics into a smooth severity score that linearly separates aggressive capitalization patterns

features.name: special_char_spam_score
features.description: Weighted combination of special character frequencies associated with spam (exclamation marks, dollar signs, hash) with log smoothing
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures punctuation-based spam signals in a single smooth feature suitable for linear SVM decision boundaries

features.name: capital_run_length_log_ratio
features.description: Log ratio of longest capital run to average capital run length, capturing burstiness of capitalization
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how bursty vs uniform capitalization is, providing a ratio feature that works well with linear margins

features.name: total_word_activity
features.description: Sum of all word frequencies across all 48 word features, log-transformed to capture overall email verbosity
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a global measure of word frequency density that can help linear SVM distinguish high-activity spam from normal emails
features.formula: np.log1p(word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_6 + word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_13 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47)

features.name: char_freq_total_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized sum of all character frequency features capturing overall special character density
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates all special character signals into a smooth continuous feature for linear separation
features.formula: np.log1p(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5)

features.name: high_freq_word_concentration
features.description: Ratio of top spam word frequencies to total word activity, measuring concentration of spam-indicative terms
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio feature capturing how concentrated spam-indicative words are relative to common words, useful for linear SVM margins
features.formula: (word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_24) / (word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + 0.01)

features.name: capital_run_total_log_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized total capital run length scaled by training set mean to create a deviation score
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized continuous score of capital letter usage relative to typical email, suitable for linear SVM

features.name: exclamation_dollar_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between exclamation mark frequency and dollar sign frequency, capturing co-occurrence of aggressive punctuation
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear interaction between two key spam punctuation signals in a log-linearized form suitable for linear SVM

features.name: rare_word_spam_indicator
features.description: Sum of low-mean but high-variance word frequencies that tend to appear in spam contexts, log-smoothed
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures presence of unusual words that rarely appear in legitimate emails, providing discriminative signal for linear SVM
features.formula: np.log1p(word_freq_3 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47 + word_freq_40)

features.name: word_diversity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how many distinct word frequency features are non-zero, normalized to [0,1]. Higher values indicate broader vocabulary usage typical of legitimate emails, while very low values with high total frequency suggest repetitive spam patterns. Score is estimated as proportion of non-zero word features weighted by their relative magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth diversity measure that helps linear SVM distinguish repetitive spam from diverse legitimate communication

features.name: aggressive_formatting_index
features.description: Composite index combining capital run severity with special character density to measure overall aggressive formatting intensity
features.expected_model_benefit: Single normalized score capturing aggressive formatting patterns across both capitalization and punctuation dimensions, ideal for linear SVM decision boundary
